meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自己修改运行环境：更新自己的记忆与指令、安装软件包、添加 MCP 服务器、改动自身代码，或创建专门负责某类任务的小助手。复杂代码改动会交给一个 builder 子代理完成。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 添加新功能、安装工具，或修改它自身的工作方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我装一个能转录音频的 ffmpeg。
say.note: 它会申请管理员批准，批准后自动重建环境。

say.text: 以后遇到 PDF 先问我要不要摘要，写进记忆。
say.note: 它会直接编辑 memory 或指令文件。

say.text: 加一个能读取 RSS 的工具。
say.note: 它会查找现成 MCP 服务器或让 builder 代写。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can change its own environment: update its memory and instructions, install packages, add MCP servers, edit its code, or spin up a dedicated agent. Non-trivial code edits are delegated to a builder agent.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask Claude to add a feature, install a tool, or change how it works.

say_en.text: Install ffmpeg so I can transcribe audio.
say_en.note: It will request admin approval, then rebuild and restart.

say_en.text: From now on, when I share a PDF, ask if I want a summary. Save this in memory.
say_en.note: It edits memory or instructions directly.

say_en.text: Add a tool that can read RSS feeds.
say_en.note: It finds an MCP server or delegates to a builder.
